title: AI World Models: Predicting What Happens Next
headline:
An AI that models
what happens next.
meaning: World models generate or predict changing environments.
example: An action changes the next state of a simulated world.
comparison: Interactive simulation differs from a fixed video clip.
caution: A generated world is not guaranteed real-world physics.
question: What would you try in a simulated world?
lines: A video plays the same sequence. A world model can generate a changing environment that responds to actions.
Give it a scene and an action, and it tries to model what happens next.
Imagine steering through a generated space rather than simply watching a prerecorded clip. This diagram is only an illustration.
Researchers explore these models for interactive experiences and environments where agents can practise.
A convincing world can still contain mistakes. Visual realism does not guarantee correct physics or reliable real world behavior.
